what: the Sun and the four terrestrial planets - the near field, where gravity is known to eleven figures and a theory of it has nothing to argue with
paper: JPL Horizons on-line ephemeris system, Giorgini et al. 1996, DPS 28:25.04

units.GM: km^3/s^2, the body's own gravitational parameter
